tasks.label: make
tasks.command: dir="$(dirname "${file}")"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$dir/Makefile" ]; do dir="$(dirname "$dir")"; done; if [ -f "$dir/Makefile" ]; then cd "$dir" && make all; else echo "Error: No se encontró Makefile para este subproyecto."; exit 1; fi

tasks.label: make flash
tasks.command: dir="$(dirname "${file}")"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$dir/Makefile" ]; do dir="$(dirname "$dir")"; done; if [ -f "$dir/Makefile" ]; then cd "$dir" && make flash; else echo "Error: No se encontró Makefile para este subproyecto."; exit 1; fi

tasks.label: make clean
tasks.command: dir="$(dirname "${file}")"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$dir/Makefile" ]; do dir="$(dirname "$dir")"; done; if [ -f "$dir/Makefile" ]; then cd "$dir" && make clean; else echo "Error: No se encontró Makefile para este subproyecto."; exit 1; fi
